vuln.name: JSONP Endpoint / JSON Hijacking
vuln.description: A JSONP callback endpoint (or a JSON endpoint without an explicit JSON content type that older browsers would treat as script) returns sensitive data. A malicious page can include it via a <script> tag and read the data through the callback.
vuln.impact: Cross-site read of sensitive JSON/JSONP data, bypassing the same-origin policy for any user who is logged in to the vulnerable site.
vuln.recommendation: Avoid JSONP; return plain JSON with Content-Type: application/json and CSRF protection. If JSONP is unavoidable, validate the callback name and require an anti-CSRF token. Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
